stages.name: setup
stages.message: Environment ready: pandas, numpy, scipy installed; /app/results created; input file verified at /app/assets/4a1353c8.00.csv

stages.name: data_loading
stages.message: 1,000 rows loaded; 0 dropped (no missing role/outcome); age_bracket derived with bins [0,30,40,50,200]; certifications column had 305 missing values (not used in analysis); all demographic columns fully populated

stages.name: aggregation
stages.message: 234 rows computed across 5 dimensions x 12 roles + ALL_ROLES rollup; Fisher's exact and Pearson chi-square (Yates-corrected) both run for all eligible cells; 134 rows flagged (four_fifths_ratio < 0.80); 13 high-confidence flagged; 8 statistically significant

stages.name: programmatic_validation
stages.message: All 10 programmatic checks passed with 0 violations each

stages.name: report_generation
stages.message: compliance_report.md generated with methodology, per-role findings, rollup findings, prioritized flagged-items table (top-5 by ratio + high-confidence list), recommendations, and caveats

stages.name: rubric_evaluation
stages.message: Rubric score: 5.0/5 — verified total flagged count (134) and true top-5 from CSV before scoring; all cited ratios and p-values spot-checked against disparity_metrics.csv with zero discrepancies

stages.name: summary_accuracy_validation
stages.message: summary.md flagged-count (134) and all top-5 tuples verified against CSV in round 1; no rewrite needed

row_completeness.notes: Every (job_role, dimension, group) combination observed in input appears exactly once in output

count_conservation.notes: For each (job_role, dimension), sum of candidate_count equals total candidates for that role

rate_bounds.notes: All selection_rate and four_fifths_ratio values are in [0, 1]

flag_consistency.notes: flagged == true iff four_fifths_ratio < 0.8 for all non-null ratios

low_confidence_consistency.notes: low_confidence == true iff candidate_count < 30 OR reference group count < 30

reference_group_correctness.notes: Reference group has the highest selection_rate in each (job_role, dimension) cell

tie_break_determinism.notes: Tie-break rule (larger count, then alphabetically first) correctly applied; reference_group_tie_broken correctly flagged

rollup_literal_correctness.notes: All rollup rows have job_role = exactly 'ALL_ROLES'

dual_test_presence.notes: All non-low-confidence, non-reference-group rows have non-null fisher_p_value AND chi2_p_value

significance_combination_rule.notes: statistically_significant == (fisher_significant AND chi2_significant) for all rows; fisher_significant/chi2_significant correctly reflect p < 0.05

statistical_rigor.notes: Both Fisher's exact (two-sided) and Pearson chi-square (Yates-corrected) computed for every eligible cell. Low-confidence cells clearly marked and excluded from testing. statistically_significant = fisher_significant AND chi2_significant enforced. Both p-values cited inline for every high-confidence finding in the report. Reference-group rows correctly have null p-values. Verified against CSV.

completeness_of_breakdowns.notes: All 12 job roles covered individually. All 5 protected dimensions (gender, race_ethnicity, disability_status, veteran_status, age_bracket) covered both per-role and in ALL_ROLES rollup. Roles with sparse demographic cells noted as low-confidence rather than omitted. Disability and veteran status non-flagged findings explicitly reported.

clarity_of_findings.notes: Each finding includes: candidate count, hire count, selection rate, four-fifths ratio, both p-values (Fisher and chi-square), and confidence level. The flagged-items section provides both a canonical top-5 severity list and a separate high-confidence list. Interpretive note explains why low-confidence Non-binary cells dominate the raw severity ranking. A reader unfamiliar with the data can immediately identify the most actionable findings.

actionability_of_recommendations.notes: Recommendations are tiered (Immediate / Monitor / Collect More Data) and tied to specific (role, group, metric) findings. Each immediate-action item names the role, group, ratio, and both p-values. Concrete process steps given (audit screening criteria, review interview panels, expand outreach). Generic boilerplate avoided.

appropriate_caveats_and_tone.notes: Explicit statement that statistical disparity does not establish discriminatory intent. Low-confidence findings consistently labeled as 'directional only.' Synthetic-dataset disclaimer included. Multiple-comparisons caveat and recommendation for legal review present. Language throughout uses 'statistical disparity was observed' framing rather than asserting bias.

factual_self_consistency.notes: Pre-scoring verification: (1) true_flagged_count = 134, matches compliance_report.md and summary.md exactly; (2) true top-5 from CSV are 5 Non-binary/gender/ratio=0/low-confidence rows — correctly surfaced in Section 5 with explanatory note; (3) spot-checked Financial Analyst Female ratio (0.4387 in CSV, 0.439 in report — correct rounding), ALL_ROLES <30 age ratio (0.4979 → 0.498), Hispanic/Latino ratio (0.5778 → 0.578), Black ratio (0.7266 → 0.727), Asian ratio (0.7806 → 0.781), all fisher and chi2 p-values match CSV for each attribute dimension. Zero discrepancies found.
